description: Defines the KeyLayoutMap class and related structures for mapping keyboard scan codes and joystick axes to Android key codes and axes, including methods for loading, parsing, and querying key/axis mappings.

classes.name: KeyLayoutMap
classes.description: Immutable class representing mappings from input device scan codes and axes to Android key codes and axes, with methods for loading and querying mappings.

classes.name: AxisInfo
classes.description: Structure describing axis reporting mode, axis IDs, split value, and flat override.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a KeyLayoutMap from a file or contents.

methods.name: loadContents
methods.description: Loads a KeyLayoutMap from given contents.

methods.name: mapKey
methods.description: Maps a scan code and usage code to an Android key code and flags.

methods.name: findScanCodesForKey
methods.description: Finds scan codes associated with a given key code.

methods.name: findScanCodeForLed
methods.description: Finds the scan code for a given LED code.

methods.name: findUsageCodesForKey
methods.description: Finds usage codes associated with a given key code.

methods.name: findUsageCodeForLed
methods.description: Finds the usage code for a given LED code.

methods.name: mapAxis
methods.description: Maps a scan code to axis information.

methods.name: getLoadFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename from which the mapping was loaded.

methods.name: mapSensor
methods.description: Returns sensor type and data index for a given absolute code.
